claim_scope: Dependency and derivative-path feasibility only; not a hydration-accuracy, parameter-coverage, force-parity, or product-readiness result.

iwm_gb_2024.decision: research endpoint only; not confirmation evidence or an OPT/SCAN provider
iwm_gb_2024.reference: Tolokh et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 2024

limitations: IWM-GB assessment is a paper/source audit, not a reimplementation.
AGBNP1 probe uses an upstream two-particle executable and does not test force finite differences.
Absolute temporary build paths are intentionally omitted; hashes make the local probe auditable.

openmm_agbnp3_plugin.decision: do not integrate; adopting it would require inventing and maintaining a new typing layer
openmm_agbnp3_plugin.example_parameter_source: Desmond DMS with OPLS-specific system construction

openmm_agbnp_plugin.decision: do not integrate; finite AGBNP1 energy proves ABI feasibility only
missing_product_requirements: provider parity and full finite-difference force gate

overall_decision.reason: No audited candidate simultaneously provides maintained generic small-molecule parameters, conservative forces, broad Route 1 applicability, and independent accuracy evidence.
overall_decision.retained_runtime: OpenMM Amber GB plus ACE/LCPO with declared applicability

steps: freeze primary paper and upstream source identities by DOI, commit, and SHA-256
separate published endpoint accuracy from local ABI/build evidence
treat finite energy as ABI evidence only unless a full finite-difference force gate passes
reject product integration unless maintained generic typing, conservative forces, applicability, and independent accuracy all pass
